content: Relationships thrive on communication and kindness. If you're feeling smothered or overwhelmed, the key is to express your feelings thoughtfully and constructively rather than resorting to toxicity. Try saying something like, "I really value our time together, but I also need space to recharge so I can show up fully for us."
